prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original mascot exploration sheet for ClearVest, a calm investing education web app for beginners. Early concept, not final production artwork.
Primary request: Create a polished character design sheet for "Scout", an original small observant shorebird companion that peeks above the bottom-left edge of a website. Adult-friendly, calm, clever and approachable.
Subject: one consistent compact round shorebird with a navy-blue head and small soft crest, white cheek/belly area, very small muted golden beak, expressive visible dark pupils in restrained light eye shapes, rounded wings. Not an owl, not a penguin, no clothing or accessories. Simple unmistakable silhouette legible at 56px, clean matte 2.5D illustration, almost vector-like, very restrained shading, no detailed feathers.
Composition: landscape 3:2 white concept board with generous negative space. Large hero pose left: head and tiny rounded wings peeking over a thin pale grey horizontal page-edge line, eyes looking sideways with relaxed curiosity. Right side three smaller separated expressions vertically: listening with slight head tilt; thinking with wing under beak and eyes up; ready with a subtle pleased expression and small raised wing. Bottom small deployment sketch shows a tiny mascot beside the navy words "Ask about your money" on a cool light #F5F7FA header. Professional character design presentation, not a full app mockup.
Palette: navy #172B46, cobalt #2457C5, white #FFFFFF, cool grey #DDE3EB; muted golden beak only. Flat white background. Text only: "Scout" and small labels "Peek", "Listen", "Think", "Ready", and quoted header. Simple sans serif.
Constraints: identical recognizable character in every pose, eyes easy to animate independently. No coins, financial symbols, chart arrows, sunglasses, hats, exaggerated cartoon smiles, robotic features, glitter, glow, decoration, existing mascot likeness, watermark.

Use case: identity-preserve / background-extraction.
Asset type: production transparent sprite sheet for the exact Scout mascot in the supplied reference, for a web companion.
Reference: the supplied Scout presentation sheet is the identity source. Preserve the cute soft 3D navy bird exactly: wide round head, two rounded swept crest feathers, huge white eyes with dark navy pupils, curved eyebrows, white cheeks flowing into belly, small rounded golden beak, soft rounded navy wings, matte soft shaded feathers. NOT flat vector, NOT owl, NOT a redesigned character.
Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, landscape 3:2 aspect, precisely three equal columns and two equal rows, SIX square cells. Absolutely no text, labels, separators, background, ledge, ground shadow, checkerboard, border, or extra objects. Actual transparent alpha background.
Every cell shows ONE same-sized head and upper body of Scout peeking, the two wings resting in front at a consistent bottom baseline. Character centered horizontally within each cell, safe generous transparent margin 10% on every side. Crest/top and lower body baseline identical in all cells, no cropping. Keep head width, eye shape, face, beak, lighting and camera identical across cells.
Cell order left-to-right top-to-bottom:
1 relaxed peek with eyes forward.
2 exact same pose but pupils looking gently to viewer's left.
3 exact same pose but pupils looking gently to viewer's right.
4 exact same pose but eyes peacefully closed in a blink; keep white face and eyebrows.
5 thinking, eyes looking upward and ONE wing lightly touching under the beak, same head position.
6 reply ready, gentle pleased expression with ONE small raised wing, same head position.
Only change pupils/eyelids/one wing as described; no change of identity, scale or camera. Copy the reference's adorable large head and plush soft rendering faithfully. This must be a clean consistent animation asset, not a concept board.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Asset: animation rig base on actual transparent alpha background.
Input: Scout pose sheet; use only its TOP LEFT neutral peeking Scout as the exact identity reference.
Create a single square 1024x1024 transparent PNG of this same Scout. Preserve soft 3D navy feather shading, rounded wide head, two swept crest feathers, eyebrows, white cheeks, large white eyeballs, golden small beak, rounded two wings resting in front, same adorable proportions and frontal camera. Character occupies x80 to944 and y80 to944, head crest fully visible, bottom edge of belly and wings approximately y940. No ledge or ground, no shadow outside character, no text or extra poses.
Essential deliberate change for animation rigging: REMOVE BOTH DARK PUPILS AND THEIR HIGHLIGHTS, leaving the two natural white eyeballs clean and empty. Retain dark curved upper eyelid outlines and all face shading. We will add movable pupils in code. This is a technical animation asset, so the empty white eyes are intentional. Do not close the eyes. Do not draw pupils, irises, highlights, dots or marks inside the eyeballs.
One neutral head and upper-body peeking pose only. Real transparent background, no checkerboard, no opaque or colored background. Keep the reference character's cute soft dimensional rendering; do not flatten, stylize or redesign.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: exact Scout animation pose atlas on real transparent alpha.
Use the user's Scout character concept sheet as the identity reference, NOT the UI screenshot. Preserve its adorable round navy bird with swept two-feather crest, white face/belly, large eyes, tiny golden beak, soft shaded 3D feather texture, and rounded wings. No redesign.
Create one 1536x1536 square PNG atlas in EXACTLY a 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equally sized square cells, each 768x768. No text, lines, ledges, props, backgrounds or shadows outside the character. Transparent background with genuine alpha.
All four poses must use the exact SAME head scale and frontal camera, same head placement and face/eye geometry. Within each 768x768 cell, head crest starts near y60, head spans x130..638 and y160..550, white eyes centered approximately x285/y360 and x475/y360. Character body ends around y720. Align the head/beak/eyes across all four poses; only wings and eyes expression change.
TOP LEFT: Peek pose from the reference — relaxed head and two little wings resting in front, lower torso visible down to waist so it can be cropped by the interface.
TOP RIGHT: Listen pose — alert and friendly, both wings resting at its sides, visible white chest and round navy body, looking forward.
BOTTOM LEFT: Think pose — one wing touches under beak, other wing at side, white chest visible. Same head geometry as listen.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Ready pose — one raised wing in a little greeting, other at side, white chest visible. Same head geometry as listen.
IMPORTANT technical rigging requirement: in ALL FOUR poses remove both dark pupils and eye highlights, leaving clean natural white eyeballs with dark upper eyelid outlines. Keep eyes open, not blank face or closed eyes. Movable pupils will be added in code. Preserve eyebrows, eye shapes, face shading, beak and texture. No black pupils, no irises.
Make the head cute, broad and gently rounded as in the original reference, not tall or conical. Each pose centered within its cell with generous transparent gutter, no overlap across cells. Keep head sizes and eye positions truly consistent so smooth transitions work.
